_nota: English texts for the roles (names, subtitles and guides). The rest of each role comes from roles.json.

guia.resumen: You are The Werewolf. By day you pretend to be just another villager; by night, with your pack, you devour an inhabitant.
guia.cuando: You wake up every night with the other wolves.
guia.accion: On your phone you will see your companions and the list of possible victims. You must ALL choose the same victim before time runs out; if you do not agree, nobody dies that night.
guia.objetivo: Eliminate every inhabitant who is not a wolf.

guia.resumen: You are The Villager. You have no supernatural powers. Your weapons are your nose for sniffing out lies and your voice in the debate.
guia.cuando: You never wake up at night.
guia.accion: By day, debate and vote on your phone for whoever you think is a Werewolf.

guia.resumen: You are The Dire Wolf: you hunt with the pack and hunger for a second victim.
guia.cuando: You wake up with the wolves and then, again, on your own.
guia.accion: As long as no wolf has fallen (nor a Wild Child or a Dual Nature), each night you secretly choose a second victim. As soon as one falls, you lose that power.
guia.objetivo: Eliminate every inhabitant who is not a wolf.

guia.resumen: You are The Corruptor: your dark bite can taint an inhabitant and turn them into a werewolf.
guia.cuando: You wake up with the wolves and then, for a moment, on your own.
guia.accion: Once per game, you can corrupt the pack's victim: they do not die, they secretly become a Werewolf and keep their power.
guia.objetivo: Eliminate every inhabitant who is not a wolf.

guia.resumen: You are The Villager of Truth: your card is publicly known and the entire village knows you are innocent. You have no hidden power.
guia.cuando: You never wake up at night.
guia.accion: Use your credibility: your word carries immense weight in debates. You are a prime candidate for Sheriff.

guia.resumen: You are The Seer: every night you discover the true card and identity of a player through mystic visions.
guia.cuando: You wake up every night.
guia.accion: Choose a player on your phone and you will see their card instantly (it cannot be changed). Your visions are saved under “See my card”. Help the village discreetly: if the wolves find you out, they will come for you.

guia.resumen: You are The Archer: with your arrows you bind two players forever (it can include yourself).
guia.cuando: You only wake up on the first night.
guia.accion: Choose the two lovers on your phone. If one dies, the other dies of grief. If they are on opposite sides, their objective becomes staying alive alone together.

guia.resumen: You are The Alchemist: you hold two single-use mystical brews in your cauldron: one saves the wolves' victim, and the other slays whomever you choose.
guia.cuando: You wake up every night, after the wolves.
guia.accion: You will see who was attacked tonight. You may heal them (even yourself), poison someone, do both or do nothing.

guia.resumen: You are The Hunter: if you die devoured, lynched or of grief, you unleash your crossbow to take someone down with you.
guia.cuando: You never wake up at night.
guia.accion: When you perish, your phone will prompt you to choose your target. Aim carefully.

guia.resumen: You are The Quiet Spy: you can peek at the Werewolves while they choose their prey.
guia.cuando: During the wolves' turn, every night.
guia.accion: Your phone will let you spy: you will see the name of a wolf. But if you are caught, you will die that night instead of their victim (and The Guardian cannot protect you).

guia.resumen: You are The Guardian: each night you shield a player from the wolves' onslaught.
guia.cuando: You wake up every night, before the wolves.
guia.accion: Choose whom you protect (it can be yourself), but never the same player two nights in a row. It does not protect against potion poison or a spotted spy.

guia.resumen: You are The Elder: your ancient strength allows you to survive the first wolf attack.
guia.cuando: You never wake up at night.
guia.accion: You survive the wolves' first attack in silence. But if the village executes you (lynched, poisoned or shot), grief strips all villagers of their powers.

guia.resumen: You are The Scapegoat: if the village vote ends in a tie, the execution falls upon you.
guia.cuando: You never wake up at night.
guia.accion: Avoid ties. If lynched, before leaving you decide on your phone who gets to vote in the subsequent ballot.

guia.resumen: You are The Village Fool: if the village votes to lynch you, they realise your innocence and spare your life.
guia.cuando: You never wake up at night.
guia.accion: The first time you are lynched you survive, but you lose your voting rights (and the Sheriff's badge if you held it). If devoured or shot, you die.

guia.resumen: You are The Whispers: you share a deep confidential bond in the village and know your ally's identity.
guia.cuando: Only on the first night, to recognise each other.
guia.accion: Your phone will show you who shares your whispers. You can place absolute trust in each other.

guia.resumen: You are The Brotherhood: three loyal kin bound by blood and honour in the village.
guia.cuando: Only on the first night, to recognise each other.
guia.accion: Your phone will show you your brothers. You can place complete trust in one another.

guia.resumen: You are The Fox: your keen scent tracks down Werewolves among the neighbours.
guia.cuando: You wake up every night.
guia.accion: Choose a player: you will sniff them and their two living neighbours. If there is a wolf, you keep your scent; if none, you lose it forever. You are not forced to use it.

guia.resumen: You are The Beast Tamer: your fierce companion bear senses wolves sitting adjacent to you.
guia.cuando: You only wake up on the first night, to learn your gift.
guia.accion: Each morning, if either of your living neighbours is a Werewolf, the bear will growl from the tablet. Listen closely.

guia.resumen: You are The Judge: guardian of the law, you can command an immediate second ballot.
guia.cuando: You only wake up on the first night, to see your secret button.
guia.accion: Once per game, during a vote, secretly tap “Second vote” on your phone: right after that vote ends, another one starts immediately without debate.

guia.resumen: You are The Knight of Swords: your blade poisons whoever dares to feast on you.
guia.cuando: You never wake up at night.
guia.accion: If the wolves devour you, the closest responsible wolf to your left is infected and dies the following night.

guia.resumen: You are The Handmaiden: your devotion lets you take the place of anyone executed.
guia.cuando: You are called after each lynching, before the card is revealed.
guia.accion: If you wish, take the executed player's place: reveal your identity and secretly inherit their card and powers as if it were night one. You cannot if in love.
guia.objetivo: Win with the side of your active card.

guia.resumen: You are The Jester & Actor: a performer capable of assuming other roles' gifts each night.
guia.cuando: You wake up first every night.
guia.accion: At the start, three role cards with powers are dealt face-up. Each night you may pick one to use its power that night; that card is then discarded.

guia.resumen: You are The Wild Child: a villager… as long as your mentor lives.
guia.cuando: You only wake up on the first night, to choose your mentor.
guia.accion: Choose another player as your mentor. If they die, you secretly turn into a Werewolf and wake with the pack.
guia.objetivo: Stand with the village while your mentor lives; with the wolves if they perish.

guia.resumen: You are The Dual Nature: loyal hound of mankind or wild hunter of the pack?
guia.cuando: On the first night, to make your choice.
guia.accion: Choose permanently whether to be a Villager or a Werewolf. If you choose wolf, you wake with the pack from that night on.
guia.objetivo: That of your choice: the village or the wolves.

guia.resumen: You are The Shadow Piper: your enchanting melody bewitches the village.
guia.cuando: You wake up every night, after The Alchemist.
guia.accion: Each night you charm two players. Charmed players wake afterwards to recognise each other. If The Corruptor infects you, you become an ordinary wolf.

guia.resumen: You are The Divine Angel: you seek to ascend back to heaven before darkness settles.
guia.cuando: You never wake up at night.
guia.accion: The game opens with a debate and a vote before the first night. If you get lynched in that very first vote, you win alone. Otherwise, you play as an ordinary villager.
guia.objetivo: Get eliminated in the opening vote.

guia.resumen: You are The Cultist: holding dark rituals that split the village into Sun and Moon factions.
guia.cuando: You never wake up at night.
guia.accion: At the start, the village splits into two groups (Sun and Moon). Manipulate debates and votes to wipe out the opposite group.
guia.objetivo: Ensure the entire opposing faction perishes while you remain alive.

guia.resumen: You are The Moon Wolf: a solitary predator that despises villagers and rival wolves alike.
guia.cuando: You wake with the pack every night, and on even nights you wake alone.
guia.accion: With the pack you choose a victim normally. On your solo nights you may eliminate a rival Werewolf.
guia.objetivo: Be the sole survivor of the entire village.

guia.resumen: You are The Fire-Bringer: you can shield a player in protective flames. If Werewolves attack them that night, they survive and the closest wolf to their right perishes.
guia.cuando: You wake up every night before the Werewolves.
guia.accion: Choose a player (you may only use your power once per game).

piromano.nota: Simplified version, without buildings (the full version will arrive with Village mode).

guia.resumen: You are The Raven's Omen: at the end of each night, you may curse a player. That player starts the next day's vote with 2 votes against them.
guia.cuando: You wake up at the end of each night.
guia.accion: Choose a player to curse them.
